CORRECT-BEHAVIOR VARIANTS, OBSERVED IN-TREE BEFORE INVERSION
============================================================

This is NOT a run of the committed tests. The committed reproductions assert
today's MEASURED BROKEN behavior and all five PASS.

This file records the run that came first. Each of the five assertions was
authored in its CORRECT-BEHAVIOR form — what the fixed engine must do — and run
against the unfixed tree, to confirm the failure is the one its defect predicts
rather than a setup error. Only after this run was each assertion inverted to
state the observed brokenness and its HONESTY-ANCHOR set to broken.

Every setup and control assertion in the run below PASSED; only the
defect-bearing assertions failed. That is what distinguishes real red from a
harness that never exercised the subject. Two are worth naming:

  - In IncludeTestsIsNotSilentlyInertForNonGo the Go control is a require, so
    it aborts the test before the Ruby legs are read. It passed: Go moves
    1 -> 2 files across the flag. The Ruby equality is therefore a genuine
    no-op, not a harness ignoring include_tests.
  - In UnknownWhereKindErrors rungs 1 and 2 of the control ladder are requires
    and both passed: the pattern matches unfiltered, and a valid PRESENT kind
    still matches. The zero under the misspelled kind is therefore caused by
    the misspelling.

The five observed failures, each the defect's predicted one:

  PreexistingParseFailureIsNotRejected
      []string{"dirty.go"} should not contain "dirty.go"
      FilesTouched 1, expected 2 — the pre-existing parse error is charged to
      an identity edit that changed nothing.
  SizeCappedFileIsDisclosed
      FilesScanned+FilesSkipped = 1, expected 2 — the oversize file is neither
      scanned nor skipped, so it is disclosed nowhere.
  PackagePrefixRespectsSegmentBoundary
      got ["pkg/in.go" "pkgextra/sibling.go"], expected ["pkg/in.go"] — the
      bare prefix test admits a sibling that merely extends the name.
  IncludeTestsIsNotSilentlyInertForNonGo
      got ["app.rb" "app_test.rb"], expected ["app.rb"] — include_tests:false
      does not exclude Ruby's test file.
  UnknownWhereKindErrors
      An error is expected but got nil — an unknown kind returns a vacuous
      zero instead of refusing the call.

Command: cd cmd/knowledge && CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./internal/ast/ -run '^TestHonesty_' -count=1 -v
Exit status: 1
Recorded: 2026-08-04, against the tree at commit 8bcb7142.

The only edit to the captured output is the absolute checkout path in the
testify Error Trace lines, rewritten to ./ so the artifact carries no
machine-specific home directory. Nothing else is altered.
